== Overview ==

Visit the Adventurer’s Guild to try your luck at the King’s Slot Machine for 250 Hunting Task Points. After 250 plays, a special guaranteed prize awaits.. You can also try the dice minigame to bet your gold. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.
